scope: source-only summary generation with thinking and bounded format retries; no semantic QC or correction
assumptions: Same source length, output length and retry distribution as the 97-paper benchmark.
All four GPUs of each allocated node run independent replicas; no fourfold charge for leaving three GPUs idle.
85% useful capacity is a planning assumption and not a measured production utilization rate.
Yield normalization assumes future work retains the observed 95/97 success fraction; it does not guarantee the hardest failed sources can be recovered.

Throughput includes full input prefill, emitted reasoning/JSON, returned format attempts and tokenizer requests; startup, QA, training, semantic correction, acquisition/OCR and CPU orchestration are excluded.
The historical untrained no-thinking Gemma estimate uses a different recipe and cannot be substituted here.
The Ornith-trained rank-128 adapter has no measured inference throughput yet.
